info.title: nullDC4WiiU
info.author: perfcrash
info.description: A native Dreamcast emulator for Wii U!
info.details:
A native Dreamcast emulator for Wii U, based on nullDC.

Includes an interactive interface that will evolve over time, a built-in VMU emulator, a controller selector, and various other settings.
Runs natively on the Wii U.

Native GX2 & Multi-Core Architecture: Hardware-accelerated PowerVR2 rendering on Wii U's GX2 API, SH-4 PowerPC JIT with fastmem, dual-core graphics intake/vertex conversion, and dedicated audio mixing with per-voice AICA low-pass filtering.



AI use: Co-written with AI. AI also used for: description text.

changelog:
• In-Game HOME Menu: Pause anytime to manage save states, swap discs, toggle fast-forward, or exit cleanly to the Wii U Menu without freezing.
• Saves & Multi-Disc: 4 save state slots per game (with undo support) and live disc swapping for multi-disc titles.
• GamePad Features: Built-in VMU screen display, real-time FPS counter, and touchscreen or Wii Remote aiming for light gun games (House of the Dead 2, Confidential Mission, etc.).
• Controls & Graphics: Custom button remapping with turbo, rumble support (Puru Puru Pack), aspect ratio options (4:3 / 16:9), video cable modes, and stability fixes.
